paper: AnyLoc: Towards Universal Visual Place Recognition (RA-L 2023)
recorded_with: the authors' own code and artefacts: demo/utilities.py (DINOv2 features + VLAD), utilities.get_top_k_recall (faiss cosine, seed 42), the released vocabulary (dinov2_vitg14/l31_value_c32/indoor/c_centers.pt), and 17 Places from the authors' dataset mirror. Driver: work/run_17places.py, driven by reproduce.py.

paper_reported.configuration: AnyLoc-VLAD-DINOv2 = DINOv2 ViT-G14, layer 31, value facet, VLAD with 32 clusters (Table III note p.5 / Table V p.6)
paper_reported.hardware: NVIDIA RTX 3090 (paper §IV-B, p.4); this machine has no GPU

cpu_cost.note: measured on the 20-core CPU (14 torch threads), 640x480 input cropped to 630x476 = 1530 patches

upstream_exits.onedrive_public_release: now returns a sign-in page; images taken from the same authors' Box mirror linked in the Revisit Anything README
upstream_exits.dl_fbaipublicfiles_com: measured 1.3 kB/s; the ViT-G14 checkpoint is converted from Meta's official HuggingFace mirror by work/fetch_dinov2_weights.py
upstream_exits.vocabulary: authors' official HuggingFace Space demo cache (the same c_centers.pt the demo would download from OneDrive)

conversion_evidence.strict_load: 0 missing, 0 unexpected keys against the authors' architecture (vit_giant2 + swiglufused)
conversion_evidence.reading: smooth decay from ~1e-5 - fp32 accumulation across two op orders, not a wrong key mapping (a swapped SwiGLU half would already disagree at block 0)

metrics_note: filled from the completed run; the keys the driver emits are R@1, R@5, diff_R@1, diff_R@5, database, query, model, layer, facet, num_clusters, domain and R@1_alt_gt
